name: The Lantern Warden
one_line_request: A watchman whose head is a rotting carved gourd, mottled orange and moss-green, flecked with white mould. Two triangular eye holes burn with steady amber candlelight. The lower rind is cut as a separate hinged jaw with ragged carved teeth, lit from inside. A wide-brimmed, moth-eaten felt hat sits low. Shoulders in a damp oilcloth coat with a brass lantern hook at the collar.
archetype: Gourd-headed night watchman of the root cellar
persona_hook: The night watchman of the root cellar. He counts the gourds every hour, and one is always missing.
silhouette: A wide drooping hat brim over a round carved gourd and a hanging jaw, on broad sloping oilcloth shoulders: a wide flat lid over a ball.
